answer: Sybil resistance should rest on work no script can fake cheaply, so I propose a public skill ladder. A newcomer starts at the ledge of a shared orchard and climbs rung by rung, each step a harder practical task: tending a real plot, then auditing a neighbour's harvest, then helping to forge a small tool others use. Every rung is graded blind by a stranger drawn by lottery only after the work is filed, so collusion cannot be arranged in advance. A failed rung drops the climber back two steps, and the whole ladder stays public, making a farm of climbers pay in real effort at every level.
